figure.message: The initial imbalance kept by head flow adds less disagreement than the imbalance created by momentum, and weight decay removes the excess on G_s (on 1 - CKA at 250,000 weight decay leaves a small positive excess, stated in the text).

drawn_texts: parts of the excess, in SD of $\Delta(y)$ over pairs

asserts.a_b: every per-pair Delta of y, u, ubal on G_s and 1 - CKA equals ~/hrh_v2_stage2_20261008/results/S2_2_v11/s22v11_summary.json values exactly; X = B + I per pair to 1e-12; sigma_y equals ~/hrh_v2_stage2_20261008/results/S2_2_v11/render/a4_parts.csv and ~/hrh_v2_stage2_20261008/results/S2_2_v11/s22v11_summary.json sigma_y to 1e-9 relative; for X, B, I the n, the means (raw 1e-12, SD units 1e-9), the raw median and share_gt0 equal a4_parts.csv; SD means equal A.A4.cells; FLOW I equals I.I4 intervals (mean_sigma, sigma_y); I3 raw differences equal the momentum-minus-flow difference of mean raw I (BAL, SMALL; both criteria; both N), all Holm-rejected
asserts.c: Spearman(log D, ||C||_op/s) recomputed per cell equals I.I6 to 1e-12 (n 192); medians of D, s and the C norm equal ~/hrh_v2_stage2_20261008/results/S2_2_v11/render/covariates_by_cell.csv to 1e-12
asserts.d: median delta_C per cell equals ~/hrh_v2_stage2_20261008/results/S2_2_v11/render/covariates_by_cell.csv median_delta_C and C.C5.medians (where listed) to 1e-12; the max per flow cell equals C.C1.cells delta_C_max; largest flow drift rounds to 2.75e-5
asserts.ranges: no plotted value lies outside its axis (asserted per cell)
asserts.v6_equality: panels_a_b (every field except y_row, drawn_v8, colour), panel_c (all), panel_d (every field except colour) and results_numbers equal the v6 numbers.json exactly after a JSON round trip; group colours differ only for default (#000000 -> #222255) and balanced (#555555 -> #6699CC)

encoding.a_b: rows = the seven arms other than SGD-K, labelled by the rule of the head (momentum, head flow); colour = initialization of the head (key row: default init., balanced init., small init., weight decay); in each row N = 25,000 is the upper strip and N = 250,000 the lower strip, same colour (alpha 0.60), strip centres +-0.21 row units; thin guides between arms and groups; dots = pairs (4.0 pt^2, vertical jitter +-0.085 row units, seed 20261010, v6 draws); bars = means on a white underlay; dashed line = 0; one scale 0.0629 in per SD in all sub-axes, ranges {"X": [-2.8, 10.2], "B": [-3.2, 9.1], "I": [-0.9, 7.0]}
encoding.c: one dot per run, FLOW x = ||C0||_op/s, MOM x = ||C_end||_op/s, y = D, both log; default-init. colour at both sizes; the two momentum clouds labelled N = 25,000 and N = 250,000 directly; the head-flow clouds of the two sizes overlap; v8: cloud labels 'head flow', 'momentum', N = 25,000, N = 250,000 only
encoding.d: one dot per run, x = delta_C (log), rows = rule of the head (momentum, weight decay, Euler step = SGD-K, 4 substeps = KS-4, 16 substeps = KS-16, head flow); in the momentum and head-flow rows one sub-row per initialization (default, balanced, small, top to bottom), colour = initialization (teal = weight decay); both sizes pooled in one colour; vertical jitter +-0.075 (seed 20261011); KS-4 and KS-16 exist at 250,000 only; dashed line = limit of C1 (2e-4), without a label (v8)

on_panel_numbers.none_besides_design_sizes: v8 prints no result number on any panel; the only numbers drawn are axis ticks and the design sizes N = 25,000 and 250,000 that label the two momentum clouds of (c)

d_check_limit.drawn_as: dashed line without a label (v8; v6 'limit of check C1')

caption_v6: \caption{\textbf{In the second network experiment, the imbalance that head flow keeps from the initialization adds to the disagreement of the head coordinates on both criteria and at both sizes, by less than the imbalance that momentum creates, and weight decay leaves no excess on $G_s$ (Theorem~\ref{thm:gauge}, Remark~\ref{rem:optimizers}).} (a, b) For each pair of runs, the excess of the discrepancy in the head coordinates $u$ over that in the outputs $y$ (left), split into the excess of the balanced heads with the same outputs (middle) and the imbalance part (right), on $G_s$ (a) and $1-\mathrm{CKA}$ (b). Units are standard deviations of $\Delta(y)$ over the pairs of each arm and size, on one scale in all six columns; dots are pairs, bars means, and each row shows $N=25{,}000$ above $N=250{,}000$. Rows give the initialization of the head and its training rule; the Euler step trains the head by plain gradient steps. (c) Distortion $D$ caused by the imbalance in each run against the imbalance relative to the smallest singular value $s$ of the head, initial under head flow and final under momentum (exploratory). (d) Relative drift of $C$ during training in each run, with the limit of the preregistered check C1 (dashed); the substep rows split the Euler step into 4 or 16 substeps. Appendix~\ref{app:exp-s22-v11} and Table~\ref{tab:app-s22v11-decomp} give the values and the tests.}
caption_v8: \caption{\textbf{The initial imbalance kept by head flow adds less disagreement than the imbalance created by momentum, and weight decay removes the excess on $G_s$ (Theorem~\ref{thm:gauge}, Remark~\ref{rem:optimizers}).} (a, b)~Excess $\Delta(u)-\Delta(y)$ of each pair of runs in the second network experiment and its balanced and imbalance parts. Dots are pairs, bars means, and each row shows $N=25{,}000$ above $N=250{,}000$. (c)~Distortion against the imbalance relative to the smallest singular value $s$ of the head, initial under head flow and final under momentum (exploratory). (d)~Relative drift of $C$ per run against the limit of check C1 (dashed). Appendix~\ref{app:exp-s22-v11} gives the tests.}

caption_v8_check.meaning: 25,000 and 250,000: the two training sizes (design); 1 in C1: the name of a check; no result number

removed_elements: (a, b) gutter group labels 'default init.', 'balanced init. (C_0 = 0)', 'small init.', 'weight decay' (now the key row)
(a, b) rows of the Euler step (SGD-K)
x label 'standard deviations of Delta(y) over the pairs of runs of each arm and size'
(c) title 'distortion by the imbalance (exploratory)', '(C = C_0)', '(C = C_end)', '(s: smallest singular value of the head)'
(d) title 'drift of the imbalance C', 'limit of check C1', 'during training' in the x label

kept_messages.a_b: head flow from the default init. keeps an imbalance part above 0, smaller than under momentum; from a balanced or small start head flow has none and momentum creates one; weight decay leaves no G_s excess
kept_messages.c: the distortion rises with the imbalance relative to s
kept_messages.d: head flow conserves C (below the C1 limit), momentum, weight decay and the Euler step change it, and substeps shrink the Euler drift
